sections.heading: Four Winds Foundation
sections.lede: Rosehill College would like to sincerely thank the Four Winds Foundation for their generous support in funding our basketball hoops.

sections.html:
This funding has enhanced our sports facilities, providing students with improved opportunities to participate in basketball during physical education classes, lunchtime activities, and competitive sport. The upgraded hoops create a safer and more enjoyable environment, encouraging students to stay active and engaged.

Basketball continues to be a popular sport within our kura, and this support ensures more students can take part, develop their skills, and enjoy the game.

We are extremely grateful to the Four Winds Foundation for their contribution to student wellbeing and sport at Rosehill College.
